notes.title: Construct VR - Audio Update
notes.notes:
We have just updated the PresenZ Player to improve the quality and stability of the audio.

If previously you were hearing frequent cracks in the sound or were experiencing desynchronization between the audio and the video, this update should resolve the issue.
Note that Oculus Quest+Link users may experience some audio glitches related to Link compression when their system is under heavy load. If that is the case, try lowering your headset resolution in the Oculus device settings.

This update will enable you to experience improved audio quality and more accurate spatialization in the upcoming Construct VR release.
